content.title: TSN on Instagram: "With a loss to Bosnia and Herzegovina, Italy fails to qualify for the 2026 #FIFAWorldCup, marking their third straight missed tournament."
content.text: With a loss to Bosnia and Herzegovina, Italy fails to qualify for the 2026 #FIFAWorldCup, marking their third straight missed tournament.And leafs fans are crying that their team stinks 😂😂Do you know how many Africans are in Italy that can play soccer.. they would die for like a €10k contract and they couldn’t come up with a good team?Nice to see Italy taking a moral stand to boycott these corrupt despotic states 😉Don’t be telling me us Italians are better at hockey and baseball now 😂Hopefully the war escalates and 🇮🇷 goes for a full out attack on the USA lmao and it's canceledItaly actively avoiding the three most corrupt World Cup hosts of all time should be celebrated.Sucks for Toronto. Canada vs. Italy was the only appealing game.Good. Italy is my last favorite soccer nation. Think they own the sport but are nothing but a bunch of soft fakers and cheaters. There's a reason they're not in it, again. 😂Italy continues to follow the same script … hire a mediocre coach, throw together a team of middlin’ players, fail to qualify for the World Cup, repeat. Italy was having a great year in athletics until these Azzuri showed up. Wonder how Dimarco is feeling right now? Schiffo e vergogna!! Fortunately given where the Cup is being held this year and all the 💩 surrounding it I personally wasn’t going to give a crap anyway. Oh well, there’s always volleyball.
